stem.text: Which diagrams show roles of mitosis?

stem.alt: Line drawing of a plant with runners producing a row of three plantlets, labelled 1.
Three line drawings in a row joined by arrows: a flower, a longitudinal section of a flower, and a cross-section of an ovule, labelled 2.
Four line drawings of a developing plant seedling in a row joined by arrows, labelled 3.
Two line drawings of a starfish joined by an arrow, the second with a larger body, labelled 4.
